source: upgrading_to_godot_4.6.rst and upgrading_to_godot_4.7.rst (godot-docs master), checked against Godot 4.6.2 and 4.7.2

changes.message: Writing one element of a packed array no longer calls the property's setter. On an engine property (Line2D.points[0] = v, Polygon2D.polygon[i] += v, points[0].x = v) the write is lost: the node keeps the old array. A script variable with a set() block changes, but its setter does not run.
changes.fix: Copy, change, assign back: var p := line.points; p[0] = v; line.points = p.

changes.message: An override without a return type now inherits the parent's (also of engine virtuals such as _get, _set, _get_configuration_warnings): a body without a return value stops the script with "Not all code paths return a value".
changes.fix: Return a value of the parent's type on every path (return false for bool; return null only for Variant or Object).

changes.message: Keyboard events now have device InputEvent.DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD (16) and mouse events DEVICE_ID_MOUSE (32), not 0; joypad 0 keeps 0. `event.device == 0` no longer means keyboard or mouse.
changes.fix: Test the event type (event is InputEventKey), or compare with InputEvent.DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD / DEVICE_ID_MOUSE.

changes.message: Default changed from 1 to 0 (no area): an Area2D with audio_bus_override no longer reroutes players left at the default.
changes.fix: Set area_mask = 1 on the players that an audio_bus_override area should affect.

changes.message: Default changed from 1 to 0 (no area): an Area3D with audio_bus_override no longer reroutes players left at the default.
changes.fix: Set area_mask = 1 on the players that an audio_bus_override area should affect.

changes.message: Under Jolt Physics the sign of plane.d now follows Godot's convention: Plane(0, 1, 0, 2) is a floor at y = +2, where Godot 4.6 put it at y = -2.
changes.fix: Flip the sign of d to keep the 4.6 position.

changes.message: Under Jolt Physics a SoftBody3D now weighs total_mass (1 kg by default) in all, not 1 kg per point, and linear_stiffness and damping act like Godot Physics. Area3D now reports overlaps with soft bodies.
changes.fix: Re-tune total_mass, linear_stiffness and damping_coefficient; use collision layers to keep areas from seeing soft bodies.
changes.verified: 4.7.2 class reference (the change is inside Jolt; the property values are the same in 4.6.2)

changes.message: width_in_percent and height_in_percent became width_unit and height_unit (RichTextLabel.ImageUnit); width and height are float. Passing true or false there is a parse error ("Cannot pass a value of type bool"), although the guide calls it compatible.
width_in_percent and height_in_percent became width_unit and height_unit (RichTextLabel.ImageUnit); passing true or false there is a parse error.
Renamed to UPDATE_WIDTH_UNIT.
The bool sync became the SyncMode enum sync_mode; a saved sync = true loads as sync_mode 1.
changes.verified: 4.7.2 (a .tscn with sync = true loads with sync_mode 1)

changes.message: The bool sync became the SyncMode enum sync_mode.
Removed.
No longer clamps to [0, 1] in the Mobile and Forward+ renderers.
changes.fix: Add a clamp node after it where the old range mattered.

changes.message: Antialiased lines no longer get an extra feather, so they look thinner.
changes.fix: Draw a slightly wider line where the old look mattered.

changes.message: Default changed from NodePath("..") to NodePath(""): a skinned mesh saved before 4.6 directly under its Skeleton3D, without a skeleton line, is no longer bound to it.
changes.fix: Set skeleton = NodePath("..") on those meshes, or enable animation/compatibility/default_parent_skeleton_in_mesh_instance_3d.
changes.verified: 4.6.2 and 4.7.2 (such a scene loads with skeleton ""; the compatibility setting exists)

changes.message: Glow now blends with Screen (was Soft Light) and glow_intensity is 0.3 (was 0.8), with new glow_levels: glow looks different, often brighter.
changes.fix: Re-tune the glow settings, or set the old values (glow_blend_mode 2, glow_intensity 0.8).

changes.message: Volumetric fog blends more physically, so it usually looks brighter.
changes.fix: Lower volumetric_fog_density, or the lights' volumetric fog energy.

changes.message: Default changed from 0.2 to 0.5.
Returns an empty path when the start point is disabled (also get_id_path, AStar3D and AStarGrid2D with a solid start).
changes.fix: Enable the start point, or start from a neighbour.

changes.message: The skip_cr parameter is gone: get_as_text(true) is a parse error ("Too many arguments").
changes.fix: Call get_as_text() and remove \r yourself if needed.

changes.message: Default changed from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds.
Kept as a stub that does nothing.
